comments.author: Marco Reyes
comments.body: Chart kit is Recharts 2.12 — checking whether margin.left needs to grow when legend.payload.length > 4, or if we should force legend to bottom under 1366px.

content.text: Chart kit is Recharts 2.12 — checking whether margin.left needs to grow when legend.payload.length > 4, or if we should force legend to bottom under 1366px.

Throughput charts on the overview dashboard look fine at 1440px and above. At exactly 1280px wide (common laptop layout with the left nav open), the legend pills sit on top of the Y-axis tick labels and make both unreadable.

You should still be able to read every tick and every series name without overlap. What happens is the legend is absolutely positioned against the chart container while the axis padding stays fixed at 32px, so once the plot area shrinks the two regions collide.

Likely the chart layout pass computes legend height after axis margins are locked, instead of reserving space first. Support has two tickets from teams that live on 13-inch displays and cannot read weekly velocity at that breakpoint.
